source.name: Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (KERC)
source.document: KERC Combined Tariff Order 2025 for ESCOMs (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM) dated 27.03.2025, control period FY2025-26 to FY2027-28
source.page: PDF page 550 (printed 534); effective-date clause: printed page 260
source.excerpt: TARIFF SCHEDULE LT-1: Fixed Charges (Per KW / Month of sanctioned load): FY2025-26 Rs.145/-; Energy Charges (Per kWh): FY2025-26 580 paise.

verification_notes: Common tariff for all five ESCOMs: the annexure is titled 'Tariff Order 2025 All ESCOMs' and Chapter 6 (page 197, 'Uniform Tariff Across ESCOMs') records the State policy of uniform tariff across ESCOMs. Hukeri Rural Electric Co-operative Society has its own separate order and is not covered. Effective dates: order paragraph 2 (printed page 260): 'shall come into effect from 1st April-2025 for FY2025-26, 1st April-2026 for FY2026-27 and 1st April-2027 for FY2027-28 and would remain in force until further orders'. Cross-checks: (1) KERC's own 'Tariff Charges approved by the Commission for the Control Period' table (https://kerc.karnataka.gov.in/uploads/85821743074692.pdf, page 1); (2) BESCOM's own 'Electricity Tariff-2026 to 2028' (https://bescom.karnataka.gov.in/uploads/media_to_upload1775021662.pdf, printed page 16). Amendments checked: the corrigendum dated 26.05.2025 and Review Petition 8/2025 order dated 03.03.2026 do not change LT-1. The fixed charge is per kW of SANCTIONED LOAD, which this app does not collect, so it is recorded with its true basis and is not billed. LT-1 also covers government/local-body run schools and colleges; private educational institutions are billed under LT-2, which is not seeded because ownership is not collected.
